releases.title: A visible version and the full upgrade story
changes: The bottom of the dashboard and sign-in page now shows the version and update date.
Open What changed to search dated notes covering the portal's earlier upgrades, back to its August launch.
Future dashboard releases will add a version and notes here. Routine Calendar syncs do not change the app version.

releases.title: A simpler employee Home
changes: Home focuses on assignment offers, the next assignments, one Pay owed summary, and shortcuts to Block time and Studio Guidelines.
Earnings contains the charts, year selector, totals, and appointment breakdown. Past work lives under Schedule → Past.
Removed duplicate cards and empty charts from Home. Assignment details expand when needed.
Live schedule changes take priority over older synced data, and repeated clicks cannot submit the same scheduling change twice.

releases.title: Support for shared Content Vault sign-in
changes: Added an authenticated identity check so the Content Vault integration can recognize the teammate already signed in to the dashboard.

releases.title: Cleaner categories, better search, and a question queue
changes: Reorganized guideline topics and improved search to recognize related words and questions.
Unanswered questions can stay in a queue for the owner to answer later, with additional suggested follow-up questions.
Saved answers can be exported for review and reimported using their existing IDs, avoiding duplicate entries.
Publishing sends changed entries and checks for conflicting edits.

releases.title: The rental rulebook becomes Studio Guidelines
changes: Expanded the shared guide to cover general studio operations as well as rentals.
Added 91 categorized interview questions with suggested answers, editable previews, and saved owner progress.
Draft answers stay private until the owner publishes them; existing guidelines are preserved.

releases.title: New teammate accounts and a refreshed login roster
changes: Added support for four new teammates, with private account activation and individual pay settings managed by the owner.
The login roster refreshes after account activation, on logout, and when returning to the sign-in tab.

releases.title: Pay changes can take effect from a specific date
changes: Date-based commission changes apply to appointments from their effective date onward.
Previously recorded payouts are preserved, while any retroactive increase remains visible as an amount still owed.
New teammates can have their own hourly or percentage rate; an unset rate does not inherit another employee's rate.

releases.title: Tag existing production teammates
changes: Fixed adding existing production accounts to a project's team.

releases.title: Safer shared production edits
changes: Fixed handling of concurrent production edits and improved shot ordering when teammates update a project.

releases.title: Faster images and recovered reference previews
changes: Improved production startup and image loading while preserving private image caching.
Added recovery for failed image loads and restored previews for older copied references and recoverable uploads.

releases.title: Private projects and individual production accounts
changes: Production projects and their files are restricted to tagged teammates.
Teammates can create private productions and manage their project teams; a public sign-up page supports new production accounts.
The studio's Productions link uses the signed-in teammate's account.

releases.title: Storyboard PDFs and more control over shot order
changes: Added Storyboard PDF export with editable notes and cards sized to their content.
Shots can be inserted by number. Removed the estimated setup value from the shot-list summary.

releases.title: Production setup, uploads, and printable shot sheets
changes: Improved project setup, team tagging, mobile layouts, and picture uploads, including custom categories during project creation.
Repaired PDF export after dashboard updates, added first assistant director shot sheets, and clarified export choices.
Improved shot-list readability and matched the production browser title and studio logo to the team dashboard.

releases.title: Navigation that works better on a phone
changes: Choosing a tab on mobile opens that section and closes the sidebar.
Overview moved to the first navigation position, and Productions adopted the same tab styling.
Improved smaller-screen layouts and controls. Employee Overview was later replaced by Home on October 15.

releases.title: A connected production dashboard
changes: Added a standalone production dashboard with individual team accounts and a Productions link from the studio portal.

releases.title: Clearer notification setup and delivery results
changes: Repaired notification service checks and push-delivery redirect handling.
Send test reports the result for the current device, and assignment setup shows whether the teammate has registered a device.
Clarified that closing the app or locking the phone keeps alerts enabled; logging out disables them on that device.

releases.title: Rental assignments in Google Calendar and conflict overrides
changes: Studio rental offers and acceptances are written into the event description in Google Calendar, without adding an invitation.
Calendar accepted is highlighted in green. Owners can approve an assignment despite a time conflict; the employee still accepts the offer.
Calendar sync was scheduled every five minutes. Actual timing depends on workflow execution.
Protected dashboard publishing and concurrent code updates during frequent data syncs.

releases.title: Availability, assignment offers, and push alerts
changes: Added shared team scheduling with one-time and weekly availability blocks for classes and other commitments.
Owners can offer studio rentals or custom assignments directly from the dashboard. Teammates can accept or decline them.
Added optional device push notifications and conflict checks, backed by the private scheduling service.

releases.title: A shared studio rental rulebook
changes: Added a searchable, categorized guide that the owner can edit or import and publish to employee dashboards.
Guideline content is distributed in encrypted dashboards. The guide was later expanded into Studio Guidelines.

releases.title: iPhone zoom fixes and clearer teammate colors
changes: Adjusted mobile input and layout styling to prevent unwanted iPhone zoom and horizontal overflow.
Updated Rayne's icon to purple and Jordyn's to blue.

releases.title: Less repetition on the employee dashboard
changes: Removed the large commission-rule explainer card from the employee view.

releases.title: Stripe reconciliation and payment matching
changes: Added Stripe payment reconciliation and an unmatched-payment review area.
Owners can link a Stripe payment to its Calendar appointment directly in the dashboard.
Deposits, final payments, and tips can be linked to the same appointment.

releases.title: Owner actions directly in the dashboard
changes: Added dashboard controls to run owner workflows and see their progress and results.
Payout marking can target an individual employee instead of always applying to everyone.
Payment review only lists unresolved balances, and manual payment confirmation uses Record payment received wording to cover invoices, cash, and other payment methods.

releases.title: Studio branding and distinct team icons
changes: The browser favicon uses the studio logo, and employees received distinct icon colors.

releases.title: Deposits, tips, and past-due payment review
changes: A partial online payment for upcoming work is labeled Deposit. After the appointment, an unresolved remainder is flagged for review.
Payments above the appointment price are treated as paid with a tip, while commission remains based on the appointment price.
Added payment differences and tip totals. Calendar sync moved to every 30 minutes at this stage, then to five minutes on September 9.

releases.title: Appointment categories and clearer reporting
changes: Grouped studio packages into appointment categories with filters and category revenue reporting.
Expanded appointment and payout reporting across the studio's services.

releases.title: Simpler sign-in and multiple Calendar emails
changes: Simplified and centered sign-in, with the owner's profile labeled Smooth.
Accepted Calendar invitations can be recognized across multiple email addresses belonging to the same employee.

releases.title: Smooth Studios Team Portal launches
changes: Published the portal with separate password-protected owner and employee dashboards.
Connected Calendar appointments to earnings, payment status, payout records, and reporting.
Added encrypted dashboard data, light and dark themes, and automated publishing.
